entities.summary: Saint Acacius, also known as Agathius of Byzantium, Achatius, or Agathonas to Christian tradition, was a Cappadocian Greek centurion of the imperial army, martyred around 304. A church existed in Constantinople associated with Acacius and possibly named after him: the Church of St Acacius. Agathius was a military leaders & commanders from Cappadocia (300 CE, Cappadocia–303-05-09). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions). Relevant to geopolitics.
